notes: Fictional records, not recovered individuals. Scientific model identical to v001; revision only unwraps infrastructure model_spec nesting after diagnostic KeyError. Full original evidence/assumptions restated here. Kavishe et al. 2019, PMC6897412 Table2: Tanzania/Uganda rural TC3.85/4.05, HDL1.01/1.16; municipality TC4.72/4.57, HDL1.39/1.41 mmol/L. Table4: adjusted female HDL+0.08; overweight/obese versus normal HDL contrasts -0.06/-0.15 and LDL+0.23/+0.48 mmol/L. Chosen continuous HDL slope -0.012 is approximate interpolation, not a published continuous coefficient. Chosen TC slope +0.05 extrapolates LDL findings and positive BMI-TC association reported in retrieved Njelekela et al.2002 abstract, PMID12656207, doi10.3177/jnsv.48.352. This is not a published adjusted TC slope. Diarz et al.2020, PMC7263614 Table2 (October2018 Maasai survey) reports BMI21.9(SD3.9),15% underweight,3.7% obese,TC177.7(SD38.9)mg/dL,97.4% weekly physical activity. Supports lean active component and substantial lipid variation, not transportability. Explicit assumptions: 55% F; age18+67*Beta(1.5,3.2); latent lifestyle proportions55% active pastoral-like/25% rural transitioning/20% town transitioning. BMI conditional means20.2/22/25 at age35 male, with +0.7 female,+0.018 per year; conditional SD2.8/3.5/4.8; lognormal draws. Lipid conditional arithmetic means use exact spec intercepts, offsets and linear covariates; softplus floor safeguards only exceptional extrapolation, no observation censoring. Age coefficients, TC female difference, group offsets, logSD0.22/0.28 and conditional Pearson0.35 are modeling assumptions. No retrieved source reports the requested TC-HDL residual correlation;0.35 is an illustrative modest positive covariance, not a literature estimate. Conditional lognormal error correlation is converted analytically from original-unit Pearson to latent Gaussian rho. Group-BMI confounding means age/sex-adjusted slopes differ from structural slopes and evaluator residual correlation need not be0.35. No observed cohort, smoking, alcohol, disease or treatment data supplied; these factors are not individually simulated and their unspecified mixture is absorbed into residual and group variation. Structural slopes in mg/dL per5 BMI units (38.67 conversion) are +9.6675 TC,-2.3202 HDL before mixture effects, not calibrated evaluator targets. All3000 records complete, positive finite BMI/lipids, lipid units mmol/L, F/M recorded sex. No TC-versus-HDL inequality enforcement, exclusion or row removal. Same seed reproduces same output; use generate(None,spec,seed). Geographic, age and adjustment differences limit transportability; fixed-parameter stochastic sampling does not quantify source/transport uncertainty. Suitable for fictional methods demonstrations and sensitivity analysis, not estimation or causal claims about actual participants.
